title: Do More Agents Help? Evaluating Accuracy and Cost in LLM Multi-Agent Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2606.05670v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Choosing whether to replace a single-agent controller requires evidence on both task performance and inference expenditure. We present BenchAgent, a shared evaluation framework, and compare six multi-agent workflow configurations against its single-agent reference, BenchAgent Core, across ten reasoning, coding, and tool-use benchmarks. All configurations use GPT-4.1 and common tool and scoring interfaces; Core executions share the same step limits. We measure accuracy and recorded token use over three runs on fixed task sets, with 3,302 instances per configuration per run. EvoAgent reaches 79.70% mean pooled accuracy versus 76.65% for Core and exceeds Core in all three runs; the other five MAS trail by 1.71-8.76 percentage points. translated_title: 更多的智能体有帮助吗？评估LLM多智能体工作流的准确性与成本
translated_abstract: 判断是否应该用多智能体替代单智能体控制器，需要同时提供任务性能和推理开销两方面的证据。我们提出了BenchAgent，一个共享评估框架，并在十个推理、编程和工具使用基准上，将六种多智能体工作流配置与其单智能体参照BenchAgent Core进行比较。所有配置均使用GPT-4.1以及通用的工具与评分接口；Core执行共享相同的步骤限制。我们在固定任务集上进行了三次运行，测量准确率并记录token使用量，每次运行中每个配置包含3,302个实例。EvoAgent达到79.70%的平均汇总准确率，而Core为76.65%，且EvoAgent在全部三次运行中都超过了Core；其余五种多智能体系统落后1.71至8.76个百分点。LLM-Debate在HumanEval上提升9.67分，但汇总准确率下降1.96分，同时消耗的token是Core的1.39倍。ChatEval在IFEval上提升22.25分，但汇总准确率落后于Core。
tldr: 该研究提出共享评估框架BenchAgent，在十个基准上比较六种多智能体工作流与单智能体方案的准确率与token成本，发现大多数多智能体配置以更高的成本换来更差的总体表现，仅EvoAgent小幅胜出。
